headline: UX Engineer
summary: UX engineer with a visual communications background and 8+ years of front-end application development. Owns the full UX lifecycle, from user research and Figma prototypes to production Vue.js, Astro, and TypeScript, with WCAG accessibility standards and reusable component systems built in.

bullets: Owned UX for a veterinary SaaS platform, running user research directly with clinics and turning feedback into product direction.
Designed wireframes and Figma prototypes, then shipped them as responsive Vue.js and Tailwind CSS interfaces.
Set front-end UX standards and reusable component patterns through code review across the team.
Partnered with back-end and product stakeholders to turn reporting data into usable dashboards and workflows.
Shipped 11+ user-centered web applications end-to-end, from requirement gathering to production deployment.
Built reusable Vue.js component systems shared across directory, scheduling, and portal applications.
Delivered accessible interfaces meeting WCAG standards, including accessible contrast ratios for institutional brand colors.
Redesigned a daily sign-in flow that frustrated staff, routing users straight to their intended service.
